subject: [PATCH v6 1/3] mm: swap: move LRU insertion out of the swap cache allocator

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch moves the insertion of a new folio into the LRU out of the swap cache allocator, allowing callers to act on the folio before it becomes visible to reclaim. This is necessary for two use cases: moving refault evaluation out of the allocation and zswap writeback dropbehind. The helper function is renamed from `swap_cache_alloc_folio` to `__swap_cache_alloc_folio`, and its callers are responsible for adding the folio to the LRU after allocation.
